resources.string: Move to a new phone, share your setup
Settings, Practice words and Progress in one file. Keep it somewhere safe for a new phone.
Send your settings to a friend as a link. Only settings: never your words, progress, AI settings or keys.
Choose what goes in the file.
Languages, look, study tools, AI choices
%1$s of study and your daily goal
Never in the file: AI keys, your YouTube sign-in, AI chats and memories, the AI custom address, full access, and Anki sound clips and pictures.
After restoring, add your AI keys again if you use the AI assistant.
This backup has nothing to restore.
Your settings already match this setup.
Shared setups never change your words, progress, AI settings or keys. You can undo it in Settings, Backup & sharing. The app restarts to finish.
Paste the setup link a friend sent you.
This isn\'t a setup link, or part of it is missing.
